title: SRS owner strategic map
purpose: An owner operating view above the execution board. It preserves release intent while GitHub issues carry delivery detail.

boundaries.name: Coherent Semantic Kernel
boundaries.actor: A maintainer of a first-party SRS package
boundaries.promise: One authoritative semantic model can be migrated and regenerated without silent meaning loss.
boundaries.durableArtifact: A migrated first-party corpus with generated conformance evidence.
entryCriteria: Epic #256 has an agreed closure checklist
boundaries.walkthrough: Regenerate the first-party corpus from the authoritative model, validate it with independent Node and Rust paths, and inspect the same canonical state through more than one DocumentView.
boundaries.compatibilityPromise: The migrated kernel has one source of truth; generated projections are reproducible from it.
boundaries.stableAfter: Core model identity, reference resolution and regeneration invariants are stable enough to build outward.

boundaries.name: Meaning You Can Take / SRS 2.0
boundaries.actor: An independent user with no access to the originating service
boundaries.promise: A Decision Logger export can be opened, validated, understood and rendered offline as a self-contained semantic repository.
boundaries.durableArtifact: A portable .srs archive plus a generic offline-readable rendering and conformance proof.
entryCriteria: Archive completeness and version-closure acceptance tests are defined
boundaries.walkthrough: Export a Decision Logger repository, disconnect from the originating service, then open it in a generic reader that recovers definitions, records, relations, provenance and a readable facet while accurately reporting any missing evidence.
boundaries.compatibilityPromise: Frozen publications resolve their declared version closure reproducibly; their canonical state is independent of the presentation View.
boundaries.stableAfter: The public SRS standard boundary: Evolution gives way to Continuity by default.

boundaries.name: Meaning You Can Continue Elsewhere
boundaries.actor: A collaborator continuing work from a clone or export
boundaries.promise: A user can edit offline, inspect the semantic diff and reintegrate without losing identity, relations, provenance or unsupported content.
boundaries.durableArtifact: A reintegrated repository with a reviewable semantic diff and preserved unsupported-content diagnostics.
entryCriteria: Semantic diff and reintegration conflict model are specified
exclusions: Third-party authoring UX beyond the interchange contract
boundaries.walkthrough: Clone or export a repository, make an offline change, inspect the semantic diff, and reintegrate it while verifying record identities, relations, provenance and opaque extensions remain intact.
boundaries.compatibilityPromise: Interchange does not silently discard data a conforming reader cannot interpret; it preserves or diagnoses it.
boundaries.stableAfter: Offline continuation and reintegration form a reliable cross-installation collaboration boundary.
